name: Elite Telegraph Scheduler
description: Turns registered elite affix attacks or scripted boss phase attacks into readable cooldown, windup, cancellation, and commit timing. Elite attacks register from Elite Affixes; boss attacks register from bossEngaged, bossPhaseChanged, and optionally bossEnraged. A later boss phase replaces that boss's prior attack set and cancels its old windups without a hit. The current target comes from Aggro Table when windup begins and remains locked. Timer System supplies time. A committed attack emits attackCommitted for presentation and one ordinary combat.hit with declared base damage for Damage Resolver, so final mitigation, crit, variance, defeat, and status processing never move into this scheduler. Stun-like effects, caster or target defeat, boss/elite failure or reset, and boss completion cancel rather than commit. Restored timers do not emit a catch-up hit storm. Intent Marks renders warnings but owns no timing.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: defaultWindupSeconds
inputs.description: Windup used when an attack omits its own value. Must be positive so an elite special is readable before it can commit.

inputs.name: defaultCooldownSeconds
inputs.description: Delay before the first use and between committed uses when an attack omits cooldownSeconds. Zero is allowed only on the attack definition for explicitly continuous patterns.

inputs.name: maxConcurrent
inputs.description: Maximum simultaneous windups. Excess attacks remain cooling down rather than becoming invisible instant hits.

inputs.name: interruptEffects
inputs.description: Effect ids applied to a caster that cancel its active telegraph. Cancellation emits no hit and restarts the attack cooldown.

inputs.name: cancelOnTargetDefeat
inputs.description: Cancel when the locked target dies before commit. Caster defeat and encounter reset always cancel registered active windups.

inputs.name: initialState
inputs.description: Restored cooldowns and active telegraphs with stable timer and attack ids. Restoration resumes timing without emitting historical telegraph, commit, cancellation, or hit events.

outputs.name: activeTelegraphs
outputs.description: Current windups: attackId, casterId, targetId, sourceType (elite or boss), affixId or encounterId/phaseId, shape, remainingSeconds, and stable timer id.

outputs.name: cooldowns
outputs.description: Remaining cooldown per registered caster and attack id; together with activeTelegraphs this is the restorable scheduler state.

outputs.name: lastCommitted
outputs.description: The latest committed attack and its locked target, base payload, and commit id.

outputs.name: lastCancelled
outputs.description: The latest cancelled attack and concrete reason: interrupt, caster defeat, target defeat, phase replacement, encounter failure, completion, reset, or missing target.

provenance: Elite encounter pass searched telegraph, windup, Intent Marks, Timer System, Hotbar Abilities, Contact Attack, Boss Encounter Script, and Damage Resolver. Intent Marks draws basic strike/close intent, Timer System counts down, Hotbar owns player casts, Contact Attack owns basic strike cadence, Boss Encounter Script owns phases, and Damage Resolver owns final damage. None owns elite special-attack cooldown, locked-target windup, interruption, and commit. This is not a renderer, generic player hotbar, damage calculator, aggro owner, or boss phase script.
